privateVars.name: jobQueue
privateVars.description: RxJS Subject used as an internal job queue for movie sync requests

privateVars.name: processing
privateVars.description: Set of tvdb IDs currently being processed to prevent duplicate jobs

privateVars.name: movieRepository
privateVars.description: Repository used to upsert movie data synced from TheTVDB

functions.name: onModuleInit
functions.description: NestJS lifecycle hook that starts processing the job queue on module initialization

functions.name: addJob
functions.description: Adds a tvdb ID to the job queue if it is not already being processed

functions.name: processQueue
functions.description: Subscribes to the job queue and processes jobs concurrently (concurrency 3) with error handling

functions.name: syncMovieFromTvdb
functions.description: Fetches movie data from TheTVDB and upserts it into the repository

functions.name: fetchFromTvdb
functions.description: Authenticates with TheTVDB, fetches extended movie data and English translations, maps to database shape
